facts.why: Rumi calls it "our pre-game ramyeon", so the noodles come before the show, and Mira complains she never finished hers. The printed order is backwards.

facts.text: the three of them sharing a comfort meal
facts.why: The film shows pre-show ramyeon and kimbap on vacation, but no beef bone soup or shared comfort meal, so the note claims a scene that does not exist.
